subject: Interim attestation memorandum request — post-report continuity
messages:
From: security@nebularisk.com
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: interim attestation covering post-report period

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last month. Our security team is reviewing and we've got one outstanding ask: do you provide a short interim attestation or memorandum that confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment between the report period end (2026-12-31) and the current date (we're targeting coverage through 2027-05-31)?

Specifically, our procurement team needs:
- A one-page attestation (signed) that the controls tested remain in place or an explanation of any compensating changes.
- A simple evidence checklist of items we can verify (KMS config, SOC2 report cover, change-control summary).
- Any preferred delivery mechanism (DocuSign or signed PDF).

Timeline: we'd like to complete this before our legal/compliance review on 2027-05-20. Can you confirm feasibility and what you need from us?

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Senior Security Analyst
NebulaRisk
security@nebularisk.com

--
Attachment: requested-checklist-template.csv (stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nebularisk.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: interim attestation covering post-report period

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can provide an interim attestation memorandum and a short evidence checklist. A few quick clarifications so we scope it correctly:

1) Coverage window: you mentioned through 2027-05-31. Is that the firm cutoff you need documented?
2) Level of detail: would a signed, ~1-page statement plus a one-page CSV checklist work, or do you need a notarized/board-signed cover?
3) Delivery: DocuSign is fine — we typically send signed PDFs and provide the source checklist as CSV.

I'm looping in Marissa from our compliance team to draft the attestation and pull the minimal evidence list. We should be able to get a draft to you by EOD 2027-05-10 for review and a final signed copy by 2027-05-11, assuming no major edits.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nebularisk.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 17:22:00 +0000
Subject: Draft: interim attestation memorandum and evidence checklist

Alex / Laura —

Attached is a draft interim attestation memorandum and a companion evidence checklist that maps to the common items customers request for post-report continuity. Highlights:
- Statement scope: confirms control environment as of report end date (2026-12-31) and changes through 2027-05-31.
- Exceptions: if material changes are identified we will call them out; none found during our internal review period.
- Authorization: the attestation is prepared by Redwood's Compliance team and will be signed by our Head of Compliance.

Attachments included:
- Interim_Attestation_Draft_20270510.docx (draft memo — please review any language edits)
- evidence-checklist-20270510.csv (minimal artifacts: SOC2 report, KMS key IDs, change-control snapshot, retention policy link)
- Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2026-12-31.pdf (for convenience)

Next steps proposed:
1) Alex, review the draft and provide any phrasing changes by EOD 2027-05-11.
2) If accepted, we'll route the final PDF for electronic signature (DocuSign).
3) We'll upload the signed PDF and checklist to the HubSpot record and share a DocuSign link back to you.

If you need us to include a short statement specifically referencing encryption-at-rest KMS config or VPC isolation for a subset of endpoints, flag that and we'll add a technical appendix (one paragraph).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment stubs: Interim_Attestation_Draft_20270510.docx; evidence-checklist-20270510.csv; Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2026-12-31.pdf

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft: interim attestation memorandum and evidence checklist

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick draft. The format looks good; one small ask: could you add a single sentence confirming there have been no control-affecting personnel changes in key control owners since 2026-12-31? That's important for our audit team.

Otherwise we'll accept the memo and would prefer DocuSign for signature. Our legal team also asked that the signed document be returned to security@nebularisk.com and uploaded to our procurement portal.

If you send the DocuSign link, we'll countersign the same day.

Best,
Alex
